headline: CONCOR, ONGC, NBCC, RITES, HUDCO and NLC set dividend record dates this week
hook: Six PSUs announce upcoming dividend record dates

modes.bear: Stock prices typically drop by the dividend amount on the ex-date, offering no net gain for short-term traders.
modes.bull: Regular cash returns from fundamentally stable public sector undertakings reward long-term equity holders with steady passive income.
modes.simple: If you own shares of these government companies before their record date, you will receive a cash payout directly in your bank account.

summary: State-owned enterprises including CONCOR, HUDCO, NBCC, and RITES have set their dividend record date for November 11. ONGC and NLC India will follow with record dates on November 12. Payouts across these six public sector undertakings range from ₹0.25 to ₹8 per share. Shareholders owning the stocks on these record dates are eligible to receive the declared interim dividends.
whats_next: Record dates on November 11 and November 12, 2024
why_it_matters: Eligible shareholders receive cash payouts ranging from ₹0.25 to ₹8 per share.

headline: Dabur, RITES, CONCOR, HUL, ONGC and Emami set record dates for corporate actions next week
hook: Six major corporate record dates next week
summary: Several prominent Indian companies including Dabur, RITES, CONCOR, Hindustan Unilever, ONGC, and Emami have scheduled their record dates for corporate actions such as dividends, bonuses, and rights issues between November 9 and November 13. Shareholders appearing on the company's register by the specified record date become eligible for the respective corporate benefits. For retail investors holding these stocks, tracking record dates is essential to ensure eligibility for upcoming shareholder payouts.
whats_next: Record dates scheduled between November 9 and November 13
why_it_matters: Hold shares before record date to receive upcoming corporate payouts

headline: ONGC, NTPC, CONCOR, and Petronet declare dividends
hook: Four PSUs announce fresh dividend payouts
summary: ONGC, NTPC, CONCOR, and Petronet LNG have announced dividend payouts for the fiscal year. The declared dividends per share are ₹8 for ONGC, ₹3 for NTPC, ₹1.90 for CONCOR, and ₹7 for Petronet LNG. These payouts provide cash returns to shareholders of these public sector undertakings. Investors should check the specific record dates for each company to qualify for the distributions.

why_it_matters: Direct cash inflow for shareholders of these PSU stocks.
